description: Source file implementing tooltip management and rendering for the Wesnoth game, including tooltip display logic, overlap detection, and interaction handling.

classes.name: tooltips::manager
classes.description: Manages tooltip display, addition, removal, and processing based on mouse interaction.

methods.name: clear_tooltips
methods.description: Clears all tooltips and resets current tooltip state.

methods.name: clear_tooltips(const SDL_Rect& rect)
methods.description: Removes tooltips overlapping with the specified rectangle.

methods.name: add_tooltip
methods.description: Adds a new tooltip or updates existing one if overlapping.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles mouse movement to show or hide tooltips based on cursor position.
